Chess pieces (standard.svg)

The chess pieces are copies from Wikimedia Commons
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:SVG_chess_pieces/Standard
by Colin M.L. Burnett (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Cburnett) and
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Rfc1394, as arranged into a sprite by
Stefan Haack for cm-chessboard (https://github.com/shaack/cm-chessboard).
